sn32.56:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn32.56:1.3: “ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenekadā vāto hotī”ti.
sn32.56:1.6: “yannūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti’. tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhimanvāya vāto hoti.
sn32.56:1.7: ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā vāto hotīti.
